meta.title: Identity meta analysis
meta.description: Public formations from the deck board and Mirror Dungeon planner
meta.emptyPeriod: No formations were published in this period.
meta.methodology: Each public post counts once. Identities, E.G.O and keywords are counted once per formation; co-deployment and deck purpose only use identities with a formation order. Every planner counts as Mirror Dungeon. This is pick rate, not performance or win rate.
meta.smallSample: Fewer than 20 samples. Individual posts can strongly affect the results.
